lines.text: THANK YOU
To Patrick Pesnot and the team of “Rendez-vous avec X”,
on France Inter, whose spirit and format
this series borrows.
This episode does not adapt a broadcast. It starts from
a news story, the New York Times investigation of
29 October 2026, and an old Hong Kong tale.
SOURCES
Daniel S. Levy, “Two-Gun Cohen: A Biography”, St. Martin’s
Press, 1997.
Charles Drage, “The Life and Times of General Two-Gun Cohen”,
“The Canadian Encyclopedia”, “Morris ‘Two-Gun’ Cohen”.
Diaries of Stanley camp internees and timelines, Gwulo.com.
DISCLAIMER
Monsieur X, the Journalist, the sound engineer and the ENA
man are fictional characters. The present-day scenes are
invented. What Cohen said about his life is not always
true: the pages flag it when historians doubt it.
Jensen Huang and Alice Huang are not accused of anything.
The suspicions reported in the press remain suspicions,
and Nvidia denies them.
